has partner

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasPartner
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPartner
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/genealogy
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Relates a couple relationship to one of its two partners.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CoupleRelationship -> gmeow:Person Sub-property of: gmeow:observedFeature

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasPartner from gmeow:CoupleRelationship to gmeow:Person when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observedFeature, gmeow:CoupleRelationship, gmeow:Person
